slides.title:
How I'd explain
~pandas~
to a 5-year-old
slides.sub:
12 ideas from one school day.
The real pandas line under each.

cells.kid: Your class register: every row is a student, every column is name, roll number, marks.
Peeping at the first few pages of a new storybook before reading it all.
Picking only the red sweets out of a big mixed box.
Lining up for the class photo, shortest in front, tallest at the back.
Empty boxes in the attendance register when nobody marked the day.
Adding a total marks column after all the subject marks.
Teacher adds up the marks of each house: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow.
Matching each student's name with their bus number from another list.
The same friend counted twice in the birthday party guest list.
Writing every name the same neat way: Amit, not amit or AMIT.
Counting how many kids want samosa, how many want dosa.
Giving your neat homework copy to the teacher.
